summary: Raw v1 reliability remains an immutable failed instrument-validation result. The 141 disagreement cells are diagnostically partitioned, controlled-vocabulary Schema v2 is frozen, and the final 30-record blind validation bundle has 30/30 abstract excerpts after six pre-coding deterministic same-stratum evidence-availability replacements. A2/B2 inputs are byte-identical (bundle SHA-256 9f0d8b785b8f8f739cdd41cf7c6f9f6fc3f7fbdf2299587cbab6d732bdddfc51). The next gate requires genuinely independent A2/B2 coding and separate completion freezes before reliability scoring; the current controller must not count itself twice.
